status_when_written: No synton run, no synton score and no rescore of any reference exists. Read so far: the paper (Europe PMC full text PMC13639185: Methods, Results, Discussion, figure legends; supplementary docx), the repository at commit 84baf1438f13fb6e03dabb8536e4f4dbfc03caa0 (notebook + 6 scripts), Zenodo 21099310 file list and CSV headers, the stored engine summary (engine/results_v2/hybrid__esm2_650m__genomecentred__mm30cpmr0p05__w8), vocab/REPORT.txt and REPORT2A.txt answer lines, and gold-free universe facts (genes per contig).
method_under_test: Herve, Cury and Bernheim 2026, microLife 7:uqag033; code gitlab.pasteur.fr/mdm-lab/papers/bacterial-genome-syntons commit 84baf14 (2026-05-23).

faithful_configuration.principle: Their notebook cells and scripts run unmodified (copied byte-identical; shell cells extracted verbatim into scripts) on adapter-built inputs data/genes.parquet (gene, replicon, position, orientation) and data/clusters.parquet (gene, representative_50, representative_95). Parameters as in the repository: W 24 (neighbour window), X 12 (context = fam50 set at 12 < |offset| <= 24), Jaccard edges >= 0.15 within a fam50, single-linkage context clusters, one representative gene per context cluster (min gene id), k_obs = representative genes of A with a gene of B at +-1, tested pairs k_obs > 1, lambda = sum over representatives of 2 nB_r / L_r on replicons with >= 48 genes, right-tailed Poisson, BH over tested pairs, sig_score = log2(FE) x -log10(q + 1e-12), links where sig_score > 80 between genes within +-2 positions, syntons = connected components (networkx).
faithful_configuration.families: fam50 / fam95 = MMseqs2 linclust cascade 99% -> 95% -> 80% -> 50% identity, each stage clustering the previous stage's representatives, coverage -c 0.8 --cov-mode 0 (linclust default; the paper states no coverage; its core-gene families use 80% coverage), MMseqs2 release 18 (paper version not stated). Members map transitively to the stage representative.
faithful_configuration.q_filter: The paper states q < 1e-5 AND score > 80; the code applies score > 80 only. Faithful run = the code. The number of significant pairs, links and syntons that the additional q < 1e-5 filter would remove is reported; if it is non-zero, the paper-rule synton set is scored as a labelled variant.
faithful_configuration.synton_to_interval: Each synton (component, all genes on one replicon) -> [min position, max position] on its replicon; one-gene holes fall inside the interval (count reported). All syntons are scored (synton-family deduplication is a representative choice for counting families and is not applied to loci).
faithful_configuration.execution_only_deviations_allowed: Thread counts and DuckDB temp directory set to the Slurm allocation; the Jaccard shard loop may run shards concurrently (each shard is an independent duckdb process writing its own file; identical outputs). Any deviation in logic is listed in REPORT.txt.

variants.V-matched (Spacedust): Same code; data/clusters.parquet representative_50 := the word method's family token on this collection (transfer_spacedust rescue3 tokens), representative_95 := representative_50 (CRE only; unused by syntons). Labelled VARIANT.
variants.V-paperq: Faithful + q < 1e-5 filter on links, only if it changes anything (see q_filter). Labelled VARIANT.
variants.no_tuning: No parameter of theirs is changed in any run; no variant is chosen by gold.

reference_reproduction_gates.dpann: Before any synton number is compared: the token DH loci rescored with blib.score_table / ribo_score exactly as vocab/vscore.py refcheck: even summed DF+TXSS excess .4270, F1 .744 / .548 / .479, ribosomal 1,686 recovered / 1,512 resolved, Parvarchaeaceae resolved 113; per-instance F1, control and coverage equal the stored DH scores.

spacedust_source207: mean best single-interval F1 over 207 regions
random-placement control F1 (200 rigid translations per region, evaluate's seeds)
excess = mean(F1 - mean control), 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap draws over regions (fresh default_rng(17) per output)
median boundary precision and coverage at the best interval, localized fraction
share of all genes and of query genes in syntons
synton size (genes) and interval span distributions, all genomes and query genomes
paired differences (F1 and excess; 10,000 region bootstrap, seed 17) vs engine reference, vs native Spacedust, and vs transfer_spacedust word outputs when they exist
wall time per stage and peak RSS
dpann_even: paired differences vs token DH and vs the word method (stage-1 words + cohesion phrases) with vocab's paired genome bootstrap (rules.paired, 2,000 draws, seed 17)
fraction of DPANN genes with a usable context: on replicons >= 48 genes; with a non-empty 13-24 window; with a full 24-gene window

spacedust_faithful.reasoning: Query genomes are actinomycetes; BGC regions are long (median 10 genes) and lineage-specific; fam50 at 50% identity splits distant homologues; vertically inherited BGCs share their 13-24 window and collapse into one context cluster, and long BGCs place the 13-24 window inside the cluster itself; score > 80 needs about >= 3 distinct contexts. Syntons will be short (median 3) and cover part of each region.
spacedust_faithful.vs_engine_reference: excess BELOW by .05 to .13; F1 BELOW by .30 to .50
spacedust_faithful.vs_native_spacedust: F1 BELOW by .25 to .45; excess within +-.06 of Spacedust's .065
spacedust_faithful.vs_word_method_P2: F1 BELOW by .10 to .30; excess BELOW or MATCHES (d -.08 to +.02)
spacedust_faithful.gene_share: all genes 10% to 30%; query genes 10% to 30%
spacedust_faithful.run_time: < 2 h wall on one 64-CPU node; peak RSS < 120 GB
